notes:
• Stellwerk for Mac: quitting, updating or restarting Stellwerk now ends its agents instead of leaving them running unseen, where they finished their turn (pushing, opening PRs) while the chat still showed the old state. A chat Stellwerk quit or crashed during comes back as failed and unread, with a note in the chat and the Operator's line "Interrupted: Stellwerk quit during the turn.", instead of a quiet idle chat that the Operator and its to-dos showed as "Idle". Agents a crash left running end at the next start.
• Chats open whole and stay put: pages start at a prompt and the first holds a few turns, Claude's thinking progress no longer fills the transcript, and on the Mac older messages load without the chat jumping.
• Mac: pasted images and videos stay chips in your message (pasted-image.png); a click opens the image in a tab next to the chats.
• Mac: a merged PR shows Continue and Archive side by side, like Conductor.
• Mac: an attachment in the message box shows ✕ under the pointer (a click removes it), and a pasted image shows itself above its chip, like Conductor.
